cms_architectural_invariants.invariant: Decoupled Headless Contract: Storyblok owns zero HTML, CSS, or molecular components in production. It operates strictly as a decoupled JSON data store returning content arrays of typed bloks[cite: 4].

Zero Production Iframe: The application renders native Next.js Server Components. Iframes are strictly isolated to the Storyblok Visual Editor administrative preview (app.storyblok.com) via window.postMessage bridge listeners[cite: 4].
Presentation Sovereignty: All styling, fluid typography, WCAG 2.2 AA focus indicators, and layout constraints remain 100% under local Tailwind CSS v4 CSS-first token custody[cite: 4].

Offline CI Determinism: CI runners execute static generation and type audits against local fixture JSON, eliminating build-time network dependencies, API token exposure, and rate-limiting failure states[cite: 4].

SEO URL Invariance: Established public-facing URL routes (/who-we-are, /job-insights, /us-govt-financial-support, /self-care-tools) remain fixed at the routing layer via server-side rewrites in next.config.ts, regardless of internal Storyblok slug variations[cite: 4].

Application Widget Decoupling: Interactive functional interfaces (TabbedInterface search engine, MainNav dropdown menus, and contact form handlers) reside in native application code and are NOT treated as Storyblok CMS bloks[cite: 4].
